text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Some time after the Drone-Go charm incident, which got her account suspended and earned her a punishment cleaning the pool, Fubuki was finally allowed to resume streaming.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ドロン号の魅了騒動による
アカウント凍結＆プール掃除の罰から、
しばらく後。
フブキはようやく、
配信活動の再開を許された──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Umm, today... Thank you so much for taking the time out of your busy schedules to join my stream.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっとぉ～
本日はぁ……
お忙しい中、
ぼくの配信に集まっていただいちゃってぇ、
マジ
ありがとうございますぅ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: This time, I, a genius beautiful girl, got perhaps a little too excited... and I'm deeply regretting it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この度は、
天才美少女のぼくがぁ、
すこ～
しだけ、
はしゃぎすぎちゃいましてぇ……
いろいろ深くぅ、
いちおう反省しちゃっておりますぅ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I don't think any of you remembers being under the effects of "charm", but... I'm really... truly sorry~!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな『魅了』にかかってたなんてぇ、
覚えてないと思うんですけどぉ、
本当に……
本当に
もーしわけございませんでしたぁ～～～！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: After reflecting a lot, working hard on cleaning, and getting sore muscles, the reborn super genius beautiful girl Fubuki-chan♡ will be working hard on all sorts of things starting today, so please support me♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
たくさん反省してぇ、
お掃除がんばってぇ、
筋肉痛になってぇ、
生まれ変わった
超天才美少女フブキちゃん、
今日からイロイロ
がんばっちゃいますのでぇ、
応援
よろしくね♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Pffft♡ Look! Look at this, Newb Big Bro♡ I barely had to kneel and bow my head a little and... lol. Look at all these "Loves", lol. They're insane!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷぷっ♡　
見てみて、
ザコお兄さ～ん♡
土下座なんてぇ、
ちょっと膝ついて下向いただけなのにｗ
このラヴ数とかやっばｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Everyone's way too weak to the charms of a beautiful girl~ lol. This is my first stream since my account was unfrozen... look how viral it went♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな美少女によわよわすぎっしょ～ｗ
アカウント凍結解除初の配信、
けっこうバズっちゃったんじゃね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm reflecting on it, I swear~♡ Higher than Sis Yama's mountains~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？
してるしてる～♡
ヤマ姉のヤマより高く～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Geez, Onii-san♡ Don't glare at me♡ I'm (just a little) reflecting on my actions♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
も～、
お兄さん♡
にらむなし～
（ちょっとだけ）反省してるってば～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: More importantly, I'm about to do a "Genius Beautiful Girl Fubuki-chan Comeback AND Revenge Live Stream♡" so you should join me in it~
text_block_list.orig_text:
それよりさぁ、
これから
『天才美少女フブキちゃん
復活あ～んどリベンジ配信♡』
するんだけど、
お兄さんもついてきてよ～

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I mean... my Drone-Go is unavailable for a variety of reasons, you know? Of course, we'll split the incentives amongst ourselves~ Please~~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
ドロン号がイロイロあって使えなくなっちゃったしぃ？
もちろん
インセンティブは山分けするからさ～～
おねが～～い♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Yay♡ Onii-san, you're so nice~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
やたー♡　
お兄さん、
やっさし～～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihi, lol. He's such a pushover. Sweeter than chocolate, lol. Now then, time to train Onii-san into a little puppy who can't live without me♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっひっひｗ　
やっぱお兄さんちょろ甘じゃん♡　
チョコより甘ｗ
それじゃ今日も張り切って、
お兄さんをぼくナシじゃ生きていけないワンちゃんに調教しちゃおー♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Then, Onii-san...♡ Let's head back to that dense forest♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
んじゃ、
お兄さん♡
密林にいくよ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: AS-I-SAID♡ Remember? I called it "Revenge Live Stream"♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ・
か・
ら♡
言ったじゃ～ん♡　
『リベンジ配信』だって♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna teach that thing that got me all sticky who's boss♡ I'll make it learn exactly "who's on top"♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくをね～
っちょねちょにしてくれたヤツに、
どっちが上か『わからせて』やるんだから♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ehe. Come on, Onii-san~ Let's get going~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
お兄さん♡
さっさと行くよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: It's too hot... I want to find that shitty jellyfish fast, teach it a lesson and then sit by the poolside with you and eat some ice cream...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あつすぎ～……
さっさとクラゲ見つけて、
わからせて、
プールサイドでお兄さんに座りながらアイス食べた～い……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: You're freaking out too much, Onii-san~ lol. It'll be alright~ This time, I'll put that thing in its place~
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄さんビビりすぎ～ｗ
だいじょーぶだって♡
今度こそぼくが『わからせて』やるんだから♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: More importantly, carry me~ I can't walk anymore~ "Please~♡"
text_block_list.orig_text:
それよりさ～
おんぶして～
ぼく、
も～歩けない～
『おねが～い♡』

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihi, lol. Onii-san, you're so nice~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひっｗ
お兄さんやっさし～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're sweating. Look, right here on your neck♡ *Poke poke*♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
お兄さん汗かいてる。
ほら、
首のとこ♡　
つーんつーん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihi, lol. Nice reaction~♡ Your neck looks delicious, doesn't it~♡ *Drool*♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひっｗ　
いい反応～♡
なんかお兄さんの首って、
オイシソーだよね～♡　
じゅる♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Bet it'd be surprisingly sweet if I licked it~♡ Makes me wanna sink my teeth in and never let go♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
舐めたら意外と甘かったりして～♡
かぶりついて離したくない感じ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: This feeling... Maybe it's my beastfolk instinct~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
このカンジってぇ……
ぼくの獣人族の『本能』なのかも～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeey~ Can't I take a nibble or two♡ What was it that Vampy said about it? Oh, right♡ "It's crunchy~♡"
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ～～
かじってもいいっしょ？♡
ヴァンピィちゃんがゆってたやつなんだっけ──
あ、
そーだ♡　
「かぷかぷですしぃ～」♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh? So stingy... Actually, you can't do anything to resist me, can you? It's my chance!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～～？　
ケチ～～
……ってか、
今のお兄さんじゃ手も足も出ないし。
チャンスじゃん？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ehe! Well then, just a little♡ Aaah~
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
ちょっ～～とだけ♡
あ～～～～～

text_block_list.name: Resort's Jellyfish
text_block_list.text: Guooooooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAAAHN?! WITH THIS TIMING?! SERIOUSLY HOW MUCH OF A BOTHER CAN YOU BE!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁあああ～～～！？
こんなイイトコで～～～！？
マジありえなすぎ～～！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Newb Big Bro! Don't move! I'm DEFINITELY gonna beat that squishy jellyfish...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ザコお兄さんっ！　
そのまま動くなしっ！
あのグニャグニャクラゲ、
絶対ぶちのめす……！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Actually, I've lost all interest in the live stream...! It interrupted me right when things were getting good... as if I'd ever forgive that thing! Hey Onii-san, run without shaking me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っていうか
配信とかどーでもよくなってきた……！
イイトコ邪魔してくれちゃって、
マジゆるさんし！
お兄さん、
ぼくを揺らさないよーに走って！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: You creepy disgusting tentacle! You freaky bastard! Eat a load of this... magic booster charge complete!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キモイ触手のくせに！
キモイ触手のくせにっ！
──はい、
魔力ブースター
チャージかんりょっ！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I am... SUPER pissed off right now! I'M DEFINITELY GOING TO KICK YOUR ASS!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼく、
今さいこーにムシャクシャしてんの！
ぜーったい
ぶっ飛ばしてやるんだからーっ！

text_block_list.name: Resort's Jellyfish
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihi, lol. Cleaned up that menace~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いっひっひｗ
お掃除、
かんりょ～～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Newb Big Bro?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？　
ザコお兄さん？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: BWEH?!
text_block_list.orig_text: びえっ！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ouch! Isn't dropping me like this kind of mean?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いった～～～～！
落とすとかひどすぎないっ！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? H-Hey... Why aren't you moving?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
ね、
ねぇ……
なんで動かないワケ？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah...! A needle from that thing's stuck in his leg!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……げっ！　
触手の針、
お兄さんの足に刺さってんじゃん！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Which means... Huh?! You're just numb, aren't you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってことは──
えっ！？　
しびれてるだけだよねぇ！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Crap, this is bad...! I can't make medicine! W-W-What should I do...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やばば……！
ぼく薬なんて作れないんですけどぉ！？
どどど、
どうしたら……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: T-That's right, the device! I'll use this to contact the resort management...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうだデバイス！
これでリゾートの運営に連絡して……！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah! Management-san?! Something terrible has happened! Newb Big Bro has been stung by a jellyfish and isn't moving at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
ウンエーさんっ！？　
大変だってばっ！
ザコお兄さんがウタクラゲに刺されて、
ぜんぜん動かないんですけどぉ！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? A landmark!? Now that you mention it, there was a tent nearby... Eh?! We're going to meet there so I should hurry up and move?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
目印になる場所！？
そーいえば
近くにテントがあったけど……
えっ！？　
そこで落ち合うから今すぐ向かえっ！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: You want me to take him there?! I know, I understand! I'm coming right now!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくがお兄さん連れて！？
～～っ、
わかってるっつーの！
すぐ行くしっ！！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: But... how am I supposed to carry him... Ah, I know! I'll make him slippery with that jellyfish mucus, reduce the resistance against the ground... and then tie him up with those tentacles...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
お兄さんなんてどうやって運べば……
あっ、
そうだ！　
お兄さんをクラゲの粘液でぬるぬるにして
地面との抵抗減らして……
最後は、
触手で縛って──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Aaah, geez! Even I got slimy! Onii-san... don't die, please!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーもー！　
ぼくまでぬるぬるじゃん！
お兄さんっ、
死なないでよねっ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: O-N-I-I-SAAAAN♡ Can you hear me? ...Hehe♡ You've fallen asleep without being able to move, you're so defenseless♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
お・
に・
い・
さ～ん♡
聞こえてる～？
……ふふ♡　
動けないまんま寝ちゃってぇ、
無防備すぎ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: A mere slave like you has made me this worried... you need to be punished♡ Then... right here... I'll leave my mark♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくを心配させたドレーにはぁ、
おしおきが必要だよねぇ～♡
それじゃあ……
ここに、
ぼくの印つけちゃうね♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Mm... *kiss*♡ Hehehe, lol. Now you're mine, Onii-san♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……
ちゅ♡
……いひひっｗ　
これでお兄さんは、
ぼくのモノ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ah, lol. I'm soooorry♡ But you're so heavy, I had no choice but to drag you here~
text_block_list.orig_text:
あｗ　
ごっめ～ん♡
だってお兄さん重くてぇ、
引きずるしかなかったっていうか～

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: But... I'm even letting you use my lap as a pillow♡ So let's call it even♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもぉ、
ぼくが膝枕してあげてるんだから、
それでチャラってことで♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So? How are you feeling? You should be fine now after the management lady looked at you~
text_block_list.orig_text:
で？　
気分はどー？
ウンエーさんに処置してもらったから、
もーダイジョーブだと思うけど～

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, that really freaked me out... Never pull a stunt like that one again, Onii-san.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～～～
マジびびったし～～
お兄さん、
もう勝手に倒れないでよねぇ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Well, that said... it was also just a LIIIIIITTLE bit of my own fault, I guess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
でもぉ？
ほんのちょ～～～っとだけ
ぼくのせーでもあったワケだし──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ehe... Which means, Onii-san♡ An apology hug♡ *Kyu*♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ってコトで
はい、
お兄さん♡
ごめんなさいのハグ♡
きゅ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: S-So now... I guess I'll go talk to the management lady~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それじゃ？
ぼくウンエーさんにホーコクしてくるね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Ihihi♡ Did you notice, Onii-san~? I gave you a little nibble when you were sleeping~
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いひひ♡
お兄さん、
気づいたかなぁ～？
寝てるスキに、
かぷかぷしたの♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Because I'm Fubuki-chan from the Bandy Sisters, who stubbornly clings on her plans even after getting interrupted♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
だってぼくはぁ、
邪魔されたってしつこくクらいついちゃう、
【バンディ・シスターズ】のフブキちゃんだもーん♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I've gotta put my mark on my favorite things♡ And you are my favorite... S-L-A-V-E, after all♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
お気に入りには、
ちゃ～んと印つけとかないと♡
お兄さんは、
ぼくのお気に入りの……
ド・
レ・
ー♡　
なんだから♡

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Taking advantage of the opportunity, Fubuki left a set of bite marks on {0}'s neck. What no one realized yet was that, among weasel beastfolk, leaving bite marks was a form of courtship.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃっかり{0}の首すじに歯形を残したフブキ。
それがイタチの獣人族の求愛行動だということに、
気付く者はまだいないのだった。
